title: Costa Fortune
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Costa Fortune”, a Gulf Front luxury 9-bed, 9.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 28 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Elevator & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf Front Home with Private Beach Access - Gulf Facing Resort Style Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $60 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Elevator - 6 Adult Bikes Included - 6 Seater Golf Cart Included SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 28) First Floor - Bunk Room - Two Queen over Queen Bunks and one Twin over Twin bunk - Private Bathroom with Shower Only - King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Theatre Room Second Floor - Kitchen, Living and Dining Room - King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only - King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only Third Floor - Master Bedroom - King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub - King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only - King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only Carriage House - Queen Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo - Queen Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Queen Sleeper Sofa DESCRIPTION: Discover the pinnacle of luxury living at Costa Fortune, boasting 9 exquisitely appointed bedrooms and 9 full lavish bathrooms thoughtfully distributed across multiple levels, providing ample room for your family and guests to relax in style while immersing themselves in the stunning vistas of the Gulf of Mexico. The first floor of this stunning gulf-front home is designed for entertainment and relaxation. As you step inside, you are greeted by a grand foyer where natural light showcases the custom art. The highlight of this level is the game room a contemporary table perfect for playing cards and board games. Adjacent to the game room is a luxurious home theater, fully equipped with plush seating and state-of-the-art technology for an immersive movie-watching experience. For added convenience, a stylish wet bar sits between the game room and theater, complete with an icemaker and wine fridge, and ample storage for all your beverages and snacks. The sleeping accommodations on this floor include a cozy bunk room and ensuite bath, perfect for kids or extra guests, with two queen over queen bunks and one twin over twin bunk; this colorful space adds a fun and playful touch. Nearby is a beautifully appointed king bedroom, offering a private retreat with calming décor and an ensuite bathroom with dual vanities and a glass/tile shower. Also on this floor is one of two stylish laundry rooms with added storage and a custom tile backsplash. The second floor is the main living area that is spacious and encompasses the beautiful blue hues of the captivating Gulf views. The gourmet kitchen is a true culinary paradise, meticulously designed for both intimate gatherings and large celebrations, featuring top-of-the-line appliances, a spacious island that seats six, and generous counter space that makes meal preparation easy and joyful. The adjoining dining area has two dining tables that each seat six and are beautifully illuminated by contemporary dual chandeliers. The dining room and wet bar comfortably accommodate larger parties but also offer seamless access to the spectacular outdoor living spaces. ‘Costa Fortune’ enchants with its second-story Gulf front pool and summer kitchen, enhancing the panoramic views of the Gulf that are perfect for sunset watching. Indulge in the private pool, an idyllic sanctuary for refreshing dips after a sun-soaked day at the beach, while the outdoor kitchen and dining area set the stage for delightful al fresco meals under the stars. The accommodations on the second floor consist of two king bedrooms, both with an ensuite bathroom complete with dual vanities and tile/glass shower. These guest suites are designed for tranquility and ultimate privacy. The third floor is the perfect retreat for couples with two additional king guest rooms, both complete with an ensuite bath composed of dual vanities and a glass/tile shower. There is also an inviting media area with plush seating; adjacent to the media area is an expansive wet bar with everything necessary for preparing sunset snacks and adult beverages. The south wing of the third floor is an absolute masterpiece, welcome to the primary suite. Flooded with natural light and shimmering turquoise Gulf views from the private balcony, this king bedroom suite is a majestic retreat. The ensuite bathroom is like a luxurious trip to the spa, with a stunning soaking tub, dual vanities, a beauty station, and an expansive walk-in shower with rain heads. To be far enough away but still close, is the carriage house, which is composed of two additional king suites, both with an ensuite bathroom, a full kitchen, and a seating area with a queen sleeper sofa. ‘Costa Fortune’ offers effortless access to miles of pristine white sand beaches and sparkling turquoise waters, making it a true haven for an unforgettable getaway. CONVENIENT LOCATION • The Big Chill – Variety of Restaurants & Shopping (1 Mile) • Alys Beach - Variety of Restaurants & Shopping (1.7 Miles) • Seacrest Beach - Variety of Restaurants & Shopping (2.3 Miles) • Rosemary Beach - Variety of Restaurants & Shopping (2.4 Miles) • 30Avenue - Variety of Restaurants & Shopping (2.9 Miles) • Publix at WaterSound Origins (2.4 Miles)
